description: Source file implementing network utility functions for MAC and IP address conversions, and interface information retrieval in the beerocks::bpl::utils namespace.

methods.name: mac_to_string
methods.description: Converts a MAC address byte array to a colon-separated string.

methods.name: mac_from_string
methods.description: Parses a MAC address string into a byte array.

methods.name: ipv4_to_string
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit IPv4 address to dotted decimal string.

methods.name: ipv4_to_string
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 byte array to dotted decimal string.

methods.name: ipv4_from_string
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into a byte array.

methods.name: uint_ipv4_from_string
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 address string to a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: linux_iface_get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a network interface.

methods.name: linux_iface_get_ip
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of a network interface.

methods.name: linux_iface_to_index
methods.description: Gets the interface index for a given interface name.
